name: Unknown
description: Has not been polled yet since being added to the system or coming out of Unmanaged status. For IP SLA operations: when we could not contact the router to collect the results of the IP SLA operation.

name: Warning
description: For Nodes - node is not responding to pings; if this continues for two minutes, node will be marked Down. For Applications – monitored metric exceeds the warning threshold

name: Unmanaged
description: The object is unmanaged (in a maintenance window configured in Orion)

name: Unplugged
description: For Interfaces – you can set an interface to be “unpluggable”. In this case it will either be Up or Unplugged instead of the usual Up or Down. See the doc.

name: External
description: For Nodes – you can configure a node as “external”. In this case Orion does not ping the node for Up/Down status, but you can still assign other monitors to it. See the doc.

name: Unreachable
description: Object status cannot be determined because it is dependent on another node that is currently down. See the doc.

name: Critical
description: Nodes - Monitored Metric exceedes Critical threshold. For Applications – monitored metric exceeds the Critical threshold

name: Not Licensed
description: SAM: For Applications – there are more component monitors assigned than there are licenses available.

name: Other Category
description: Never to be placed on an object. CategoryStatusMap allows joining back to StatusInfo to place statues into one of several buckets. This status value is the result of a status that is not "relevant" from an "issue" perspective and deserves to be in the "other" bucket.

name: Not Running
description: For SAM processes and IIS Application Pools that are not running. This status is not issue (it is expected state) so it is ignored in final application status roll up.
